diagnostics.text:
Post a reminder. Instruction: Post a shared handling reminder in the affected threads and direct tutors to collect playback examples in the existing batch thread. Draft to copy: For audio batch 06, a player that never loads or shows a waveform without starting playback should be reported as a tool incident. Include the task ID, browser and error state, error time, reproduction details, and whether another clip plays; keep both task references if one plays and the other does not.

Do not assign a model-quality failure or content QN solely because playback is unavailable. Retain any separate accessible content concerns for review. Please keep examples in the existing batch playback thread while the scope is checked. These handling instructions do not mean playback has been repaired, and the old workaround still needs review before use. Why this helps: A shared reminder can answer the repeated QN question and standardize the details collected. It follows current project and batch guidance, but mostly repeats existing instructions and does not itself advance engineering investigation of the multiple reported failures.
diagnostics.rationale: The technical-incident reminder and diagnostic requirements follow current guidance. However, its listed premises do not establish directing these reporters to the existing batch example-collection thread; the cited collection note is not operational playback-handling guidance.

diagnostics.text: No action needed now. Instruction: Hold a new consolidated escalation until you have reviewed the missing reproduction details and the earlier reload trial's outcome. Draft to copy: No new consolidated escalation yet: I will review the task references and reproduction details, then check the earlier reload trial's results and any later approval before deciding whether it applies. The prior trial was limited to the previous batch and has expired. Continue reporting individual tool incidents under current guidance; do not infer a content failure from unavailable playback. Why this helps: Current thread instructions support gathering details before deciding whether the old workaround applies, and historical records do not establish an extension or observed trial outcome. They do not support delaying current incident reporting, so waiting on a consolidated escalation is a poor fit for the assessed high severity.
diagnostics.rationale: Reviewing diagnostics and trial outcomes before deciding workaround applicability is supported. Holding a consolidated escalation pending that review is not justified by those requirements, and the alternative itself acknowledges the poor fit with the multiple current reports.
